summary: Most frontend performance/SEO/accessibility work is represented in the diff: static robots.txt and sitemap.xml added, OptimizedImage updated for AVIF/WebP + priority/lazy behaviors, index.html preloads updated, service worker caching/version cleanup improved, code-splitting preserved, and build config drops console logs. However, the actual optimized image asset files are not shown as added, and the sitemap content appears incomplete versus the requirement for key sections. There are also backend changes that were not requested for this performance/SEO task.

missing_requirements.requirement: New optimized hero and logo assets exist in the repo as static files and are referenced by the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: The UI references AVIF/WebP variants and the service worker pre-caches them, but the diff does not show the required optimized image files being added to the repo (only robots.txt and sitemap.xml were added).
evidence: ADDED FILES section only includes frontend/public/robots.txt and frontend/public/sitemap.xml

missing_requirements.requirement: The sitemap includes at minimum the homepage and key sections/anchors that are meaningful as standalone URLs (only include valid URL entries).
missing_requirements.reason: The added static sitemap.xml contains only a single <url> entry for the homepage; no additional meaningful standalone URLs are included.

missing_requirements.requirement: All images rendered through OptimizedImage include explicit width/height (or equivalent aspect-ratio stability) to avoid layout shifts.
missing_requirements.reason: OptimizedImage accepts optional width/height but does not enforce them nor provide a clear always-on aspect-ratio fallback when width/height are omitted; the diff does not provide enough evidence that all call sites pass width/height.
evidence: frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.tsx (width/height are optional props; containIntrinsicSize uses 'auto' when missing)
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx (shows one usage with width/height provided, but not evidence for all usages)
